name: nsight-profiling
description: Profile GPU and MPI applications with NVIDIA Nsight Systems/Compute (nsys/ncu) on isolated HPC clusters: per-rank wrapper injection, replay control, Grid-Size fingerprinting, and latency-bound detection from the CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Profile GPU/MPI apps with nsys and ncu.
interface.longDescription: Practical patterns for profiling GPU and MPI applications with NVIDIA Nsight Systems and Compute (nsys/ncu) on externally-isolated HPC clusters: disabling debuginfod symbol resolution to avoid hangs, injecting per-rank nsys wrappers under mpiexec, controlling ncu kernel replay and collection windows, using Grid Size as a kernel fingerprint to classify sub-problems, judging latency-bound kernels via Long Scoreboard, and reading results from the CLI alone.
defaultPrompt: Profile my GPU/MPI application with Nsight Systems and Compute.
